name: Hot and Sour Soup
subtitle: thick pepper and vinegar soup with shredded vegetables, on every Indian Chinese menu

ingredients.note: white vinegar, and more at the table
the heat here is pepper, not chilli

prepNotes: Hot from pepper, sour from vinegar. Neither should be shy.
The soup is thickened until a spoon leaves a track. Thin hot and sour soup is just vegetable water.

steps.text: Fry the garlic and ginger in the oil for 30 seconds, then add all the vegetables and toss on high 3 minutes.
steps.tip: They should keep their bite. This is not a stew.

steps.text: Add the water, soy sauce and half the pepper. Simmer 8 minutes.
Slake the cornflour in 150ml cold water and stir it in steadily until the soup thickens and turns glossy.
steps.tip: Cold water. Dropped into hot liquid dry, cornflour lumps instantly.

steps.text: Add the vinegar and the rest of the pepper off the heat.
steps.tip: Vinegar boiled hard loses its edge, which is the point of it.

steps.text: Check the salt, scatter spring onion, and serve with extra vinegar and chilli on the side.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. It thickens further as it cools, so loosen with hot water and re-sharpen with a splash of vinegar when reheating.
